allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Stephen, an international trader, tracks down his ex-wife Patricia in some Amazonian backwater. He needs her consent to a divorce so that he can marry Charlotte. Unfortunately, he discovers a son he didn’t know he had – Mimi-Siku. The young jungle boy yearns to see Paris so Stephen reluctantly agrees to take him back home with him for a few days. How will Mimi-Siku react to life in the great metropolis?

facts.title: Little Indian, Big City

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Raised deep in the Amazon, how will young Mimi-Siku handle the towering rush and strange rules of the French capital?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Seeking a divorce to remarry, trader Stephen tracks his ex-wife to the Amazon, only to discover a son he never knew existed. When the boy longs to see Paris, Stephen reluctantly brings him home for a brief visit.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Lighthearted, comic, and warm-spirited, offering an accessible 90-minute family clash of cultures.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by Hervé Palud, this breezy French family comedy blends classic fish-out-of-water humor with genuine warmth as jungle life collides head-on with urban routine.
